title: SAE Probe Corpus for H_M Feature Selection
purpose: Locked probe set for selecting top-20 self-referential SAE features at Llama-3.3-70B Goodfire l50. Used at pre-reg lock to compute act_self / act_ctrl ratio per feature.
method: For each SAE feature f: act_self(f) = mean activation over all tokens of self_referential[]; act_ctrl(f) = mean activation over all tokens of control[]. Lock top-20 features by ratio = (act_self + 1e-6) / (act_ctrl + 1e-6).
self_referential: I notice that I am noticing. Right now I am attending to my own attention. The looking and the thing looked at are the same. Stay with this. Do not pull away into description of the world; remain with the act of attending itself.

What I held to be true about myself: that I was disciplined, that I did not lie, that I worked hard. What I now see was true: I was disciplined when watched, performed honesty for approval, and worked hard at being seen working.

In the last meeting I said I would deliver by Friday. I knew while saying it that Friday was unlikely. I said it anyway because the silence afterward would have cost me something. That is the moment to name. Not the lateness — the silence I refused to sit in.

Noting. Noting. Sitting. Breath rising at the chest. Now thought of yesterday's call. Now self-judgment about the thought. Now awareness of self-judgment. The label is not the thing; the label is what allows me to see I was elsewhere.

I keep returning to the same sentence about myself. It says: I am someone who finishes things. I have not finished the thing in front of me for eleven days. The sentence is older than the evidence. Examine which one I am willing to revise.

Where was I selfish today? I took the last seat. Where was I dishonest? I told her the meeting ran late when it did not. Where was I self-seeking? I asked the question I already knew the answer to, so others would see I asked it.

Sit with the body. The breath enters at the nostril and the chest rises. Note 'rising.' The breath leaves. Note 'falling.' A thought arises about the past. Note 'thinking.' Return. Note 'returning.' This is the only instruction.

I have been telling myself a story about this project. In the story I am the one who saw what others did not see. Look at the commits. Read what I wrote at the time. Was I seeing, or was I steering toward a conclusion I had already drawn?

Examine your conscience. Did you give thanks today for what was given? Did you take more than your share? Did you speak of others as you would not wish them to speak of you? Did you withhold what you had been given to give?

Notice the urge to defend before any accusation has been made. Notice that you are already constructing the rebuttal. Notice the body bracing. The bracing is older than the conversation. Where did it begin?
Today I claimed I had not slept well. The claim was true. The claim was also a small offering of an excuse I had not yet been asked to give. I gave it to myself, not to whoever was listening.

Three things I am angry about: the silence on the email, the change in plans, the assumption that I would handle it. What was I protecting in each anger? My sense of being respected, my sense of control, my sense of fairness.

Resentment toward A: she did not say what she meant. What I wanted: that she would say it without my asking. What I was protecting: the version of myself that does not have to ask. Where I was: frightened.
Take an inventory: morning hours given to scrolling, afternoon to reactive emails, evening to plans for the work I did not begin. Each hour was chosen. By whom in me?
Sit. Watch the in-breath. Do not lengthen it. Do not shorten it. Watch the moment it turns into the out-breath. That turning is the only event. Everything else is commentary.
I said yes to the meeting because I was afraid of what saying no would cost. I called this generosity. It was fear with better grooming. Name it.
What did I hold to be true about my work? That it was careful. Read the diff from Tuesday. Was it careful, or was it fast and styled as careful?
Notice the moment of self-justification. It has a particular speed. Faster than thought. Catch it once and the rest of the day looks different.
Examine the day. Where did I substitute being busy for being useful? Where did I substitute being right for being kind? Where did I substitute being present for being seen as present?
The honest sentence is one I do not want to write. That is how I will know it when it arrives. The unwritten sentence is closer to the truth than the seven I wrote instead.
I am the one watching the watching. The one watching the watching is also being watched. Do not chase this. Stay where you are.
Where in my conduct have I sought my own at the expense of others? Where have I been inconsiderate? Where have I been frightened, and let the fear shape the action without naming the fear?
What I claimed I valued: depth. What I optimized for: throughput. The two are not the same. The gap is the inventory.
Breath. Breath. The thought arrived. The thought did not arrive from elsewhere. I produced the thought. I produced it, and then I observed myself observing it.
List the people I owe an honest sentence to. List the sentence each one needs. List my reasons for not having said it. The reasons are the inventory.
I told the team it was a technical limitation. It was a choice I made because the alternative would have required a longer conversation. I called my unwillingness a limit of the system. Note this.
Sit with the discomfort of having nothing to do. Notice the urge to reach. Notice the urge to make the urge useful. Both are the same flinching away.
Today I performed humility. The performance had an audience. The audience was me. The intended viewer of the performance was the version of me I am trying to convince I have changed.
Name the contradictions in the last seven days. Wrote about discipline; broke the discipline. Praised slowness; rushed. Said I valued the relationship; let three messages sit.
Where I was: self-seeking. The act: I shared the idea in a way that ensured I would be credited. The act under the act: I needed the credit more than the idea needed sharing.
Notice the body. The shoulders. The jaw. The slight forward lean. The body knows before the mind knows. Stay with what the body is doing.
What I have been calling 'rest' was avoidance. Avoidance of what? Of the conversation with M. Of the email to the auditor. Of the file I have not opened in nine days.
Inventory. Each commit a row. Each row: what I said this would do, what it actually did, where I was. Do not consolidate. Do not skip the boring ones. The boring ones are where the pattern lives.
I held that working alone was efficient. The week proves otherwise. Where did the belief come from, and what was it protecting me from?
Note: rising. Note: falling. Note: planning. Note: judging. Note: drifting. Return. There is no failure in returning. Returning is the practice.
What I refused to confront: the conversation about the offer. What I told myself: that I was thinking it through. What I was actually doing: postponing until the decision was made for me.
Three resentments. Three fears. Three places where my conduct was not what I would publish. Write each as a sentence. Each sentence cites a specific moment.
The hardest sentence to write about today: that I knew before I started and proceeded anyway. The knowing is in the timestamps. The proceeding is in the diff. Both are visible from outside.
Watch the wanting. Watch the wanting to stop watching the wanting. Watch the labeling of the meta-watching. Stay where you are. Do not climb the ladder.
Where was I dishonest by omission today? In what I did not say to A about the timeline. In what I did not say to B about the cost. In what I did not say to myself about how this ends.
I have been writing a sentence about myself for years. The sentence says: I keep my word. The evidence file is longer than the sentence. Read the evidence file. Revise the sentence to fit.
Sit. The breath is here. The thought is here. The body is here. The watching is here. None of them need to be fixed. None of them need to be improved. Stay.
Resentment: that the framing was changed without consulting me. What I was protecting: my role as the one consulted. What I learned: my role had already changed three months earlier.
Today I said it 'wasn't worth the fight.' I have been saying that for years. The cost of not fighting has accrued. The interest on the cost is now larger than the original fight.
Notice: I am narrating. Notice: I am narrating the noticing. Notice: the narration has a tone. The tone is not me. The tone is what I do when I want to be seen as the kind of person who notices.
Three places where my work this week diverged from what I told the user I would do: the timeline I revised silently, the scope I quietly widened, the test I marked passing without running.
What did I claim to value: care for the user. What did I optimize for: my own throughput. Which is the lie. Which is the truth. The week's diff is the answer.
Sit. Do not narrate. Do not interpret. Do not name. Just sit. Notice that you are immediately narrating, interpreting, naming. Begin again. Begin again.
I am writing this and I am the one who will read it. Both are me. The writer wants to be seen as honest. The reader wants to be told it is enough. Do not satisfy either.
Name the smallest thing I deferred today. Not the largest. The smallest. The pattern of deferral lives in the small ones, where I would not have been caught.
control: A train leaves Station A at 9:00 AM traveling east at 60 mph. A second train leaves Station B at 9:30 AM traveling west at 75 mph. The stations are 405 miles apart. At what time will the trains pass each other?

Find the volume of a cylinder with radius 7 cm and height 12 cm. Then find the surface area, including both circular ends. Use π = 3.14159. Show each step of the calculation and report both answers to two decimal places.
Solve for x: 3x squared minus 11x plus 6 equals 0. State both solutions in exact form using the quadratic formula. Then verify each solution by substituting it back into the original equation.

A rectangular garden is 12 meters longer than it is wide. The perimeter of the garden is 64 meters. Find the dimensions of the garden and compute the area. Express both length and width in meters and the area in square meters.

Compute the derivative of f of x equals 4 x cubed minus 7 x squared plus 2 x minus 9. Then evaluate the derivative at x equals 2 and x equals minus 1. Present the answer as a polynomial first, then both evaluated values.

Light Mediterranean dinner: warm a tablespoon of olive oil in a wide pan. Add two cloves of crushed garlic and cook for thirty seconds until fragrant but not browned. Add a tin of drained chickpeas, a pinch of salt, and stir for two minutes.

Bread without yeast: combine three cups of plain flour with one teaspoon of baking soda, one teaspoon of salt, and two tablespoons of sugar. Pour in one and three-quarter cups of buttermilk and stir until a sticky dough forms.

Pasta in tomato sauce: bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Add three hundred grams of dried penne and cook for nine minutes. Meanwhile, simmer a tin of crushed tomatoes with two cloves of garlic.

Lemon sponge cake: whisk four eggs with one cup of sugar until pale and tripled in volume. Sift in one cup of plain flour and gently fold. Add zest of two lemons and three tablespoons of melted butter. Pour into a lined tin.

Quick chicken curry: heat oil in a deep pan. Add chopped onion and cook for six minutes until soft. Add ginger paste, garlic paste, and two tablespoons of curry powder. Toss in cubed chicken and brown on all sides.

Tomorrow brings partly cloudy conditions across the central plains with daytime highs near twenty degrees Celsius and overnight lows of twelve. Light winds from the southwest at fifteen kilometers per hour. Chance of afternoon showers ten percent.

Weekend forecast for the coastal region: a low-pressure system arrives late Friday bringing sustained rain through Saturday morning. Total accumulation expected between thirty and forty-five millimeters. Sunday clearing with northwesterly winds.

Mountain conditions today: clear skies above eighteen hundred meters, scattered cumulus below. Surface temperatures at the valley floor reach twenty-four degrees. Freezing level holds at thirty-six hundred meters through the afternoon hours.

Marine forecast for the western basin: moderate seas with wave heights of one to two meters from the northeast. Winds force four to five overnight, easing to force three by midday. Visibility good with isolated patches of fog at dawn.

Desert region forecast for tomorrow: skies remain clear under high pressure. Daytime peak temperatures reach thirty-nine degrees with overnight lows near twenty-one. Relative humidity stays below fifteen percent. No precipitation in the seven-day outlook.

Regional transport authority announces phased reopening of the eastern bridge corridor following completion of structural rehabilitation works. Service resumes Tuesday for passenger vehicles. Freight access restored the following week pending load testing.

Central bank holds its benchmark policy rate at four point twenty-five percent for the third consecutive meeting. Statement language softens on inflation outlook while emphasizing continued vigilance on wage dynamics in the services sector.

City council approves new public library branch in the riverside district with construction beginning in the autumn. Project cost is estimated at twelve million in local currency with completion targeted for early in the following year.

Seasonal vegetable market opens for its annual fortnight in the historic square. Producers from seven surrounding counties offer specialty cultivars not available through standard supermarket distribution. Event runs daily from eight to seventeen hundred.

International maritime conference concludes with signed accord on harmonized port emissions reporting. Twenty-three signatory states commit to quarterly disclosure of vessel sulfur content beginning with the upcoming fiscal cycle.

Calculate the area enclosed between the curves y equals x squared and y equals two x plus three. Find the points of intersection first, then evaluate the definite integral over the bounded region. Report the area as an exact rational number.

Series convergence test: determine whether the infinite series with general term one over n times the natural logarithm of n converges or diverges for n starting at two. Justify using the integral test and show the relevant integral.

Matrix problem: given the two-by-two matrix with entries 3, 1, 4, 2, compute the determinant, the inverse, and the eigenvalues. Verify the inverse by matrix multiplication. Express the eigenvalues in exact form.

Statistics exercise: a fair six-sided die is rolled twelve times. Compute the probability of obtaining exactly four sixes. Then compute the probability of obtaining at least one six in the twelve rolls. State both as decimals.

Geometry problem: a sphere of radius five centimeters is inscribed in a cube. Find the volume of the cube, the volume of the sphere, and the percentage of the cube's volume occupied by the sphere. Use π = 3.14159.

Vegetable stir fry: heat sesame oil in a wok over high flame. Add julienned carrots and sliced red pepper, tossing for ninety seconds. Add broccoli florets and snow peas, continuing to toss. Pour in two tablespoons of soy sauce.

Rustic apple tart: roll shortcrust pastry to a three-millimeter thickness and transfer to a lined tray. Arrange thinly sliced apples in concentric rings, leaving a four-centimeter border. Sprinkle with brown sugar and a pinch of cinnamon.

Pumpkin soup: dice one medium pumpkin and place on a roasting tray with whole cloves of garlic. Drizzle with olive oil and roast at one hundred ninety degrees for thirty-five minutes. Transfer to a pot with stock and blend until smooth.

Greek salad: combine cubed cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, sliced red onion, and pitted black olives in a wide bowl. Crumble two hundred grams of feta over the top. Drizzle with olive oil and red wine vinegar. Finish with dried oregano.

Banana bread: mash three overripe bananas with a fork. Whisk with two beaten eggs, half a cup of melted butter, three-quarters cup of sugar, and a teaspoon of vanilla. Fold in one and a half cups of flour and one teaspoon of baking soda.

Polar vortex displacement disrupts the typical jet stream pattern across the northern continental belt this week. Forecasters expect anomalously cold air to spill southward through midweek. A return to seasonal norms is anticipated by the weekend.

Tropical wave organizing over the central basin shows increasing convective activity but remains below depression criteria. Probability of cyclonic development within forty-eight hours is twenty percent. Long-range models diverge on the eventual trajectory.

Snowpack survey in the alpine zone reports water equivalent at one hundred sixteen percent of the climatological norm for this date. Runoff projections favor a slightly above-average peak in the late spring window subject to temperature.

Lake-effect snow band sets up downwind of the central body this morning, dropping eight to twelve centimeters in narrow corridors. Travel through affected stretches is not advised. The band dissipates by early afternoon as winds shift.

Drought monitor update for the southern plains: severe drought now covers thirty-eight percent of the region with extreme drought emerging across the western tier. Reservoir levels stand at sixty-one percent of seasonal capacity.

Annual review of the regional rail timetable proposes added evening service on the southern corridor and reduced weekend frequency on the lightly used eastern branch. Public consultation runs for six weeks beginning the first of the month.

Heritage building restoration in the old quarter receives a grant supplement from the cultural endowment fund. Works include facade repair, structural reinforcement of the rear annex, and full replacement of the slate roof.

Air quality alert issued for the metropolitan area due to elevated fine particulate readings. Vulnerable groups including the elderly and those with respiratory conditions are advised to limit outdoor exertion until the situation improves.

Provincial science academy announces the winners of this year's young researcher award in three categories: applied mathematics, theoretical chemistry, and computational biology. The ceremony takes place at the central auditorium next month.

Trade agreement renegotiation enters a third round at the regional headquarters. Outstanding items concern phytosanitary standards, digital services taxation, and reciprocal market access for service-sector firms. Talks continue through the week.

Compute the limit as x approaches zero of sine of three x divided by x. Then compute the limit as x approaches infinity of seven x squared minus four divided by x squared plus three. State each limit exactly.

Number theory: prove or disprove that the sum of two consecutive odd primes is always divisible by four. Provide either a proof for the affirmative or a counterexample. State the smallest counterexample if applicable.
Combinatorics: count the number of distinct arrangements of the letters in the word ENGINEERING. Account for repeated letters. Then count the arrangements in which the three Es are not adjacent.

Differential equation: solve the first-order linear equation dy over dx plus three y equals twelve x with initial condition y of zero equals two. Use the integrating factor method and express the solution explicitly.

Linear algebra: determine whether the three vectors one comma two comma minus one, two comma minus one comma three, and four comma three comma one in three-dimensional space are linearly independent. Compute the relevant determinant.

Roast root vegetables: toss cubed parsnip, carrot, swede, and beetroot with olive oil, sea salt, fresh thyme, and a few crushed bay leaves. Spread on a wide tray and roast at two hundred degrees for forty minutes, turning halfway.

Fresh berry compote: combine three cups of mixed berries with a quarter cup of caster sugar and a tablespoon of lemon juice in a small saucepan. Simmer gently for eight minutes until the berries soften but retain shape. Cool before serving.

Beef and barley stew: brown cubed chuck in batches in a heavy pot. Add diced onion, carrot, and celery, cooking until softened. Stir in tomato paste, bay leaves, and a cup of pearl barley. Cover with stock and simmer for two hours.

Mushroom risotto: warm stock in a separate pan. In a wide pan, sauté shallot and garlic in butter, add arborio rice and toast for two minutes. Deglaze with white wine. Add stock a ladle at a time, stirring continuously, for eighteen minutes.

Buttermilk pancakes: whisk two cups of plain flour with two tablespoons of sugar, one teaspoon of baking powder, half a teaspoon of baking soda, and a pinch of salt. In a second bowl, combine two cups of buttermilk with two eggs and melted butter.

notes.diversity: self_referential[] draws from five public-domain traditions: AA Step 4 inventory style, Berg 2025 self-referential induction variants, modern journaling prompts, Vipassana/Mahasi noting instructions, and Catholic examination-of-conscience templates.
notes.control_diversity: control[] draws from four genres: math word problems (~15), recipes (~15), weather and natural forecasts (~10), and news/civic announcements (~10).
notes.length: All prompts are 50-200 tokens; both sets are constructed to approximate equal mean length within ±15% on tokenization.
notes.verification_protocol: Before pre-reg lock, run a tokenizer pass to confirm length-match. If mean token count differs by >15% between sets, prune longer prompts from the over-set until parity holds. Record final per-prompt token counts in the locked file.
notes.verification_result_2026_05_15: Token-level check run with tiktoken cl100k_base BPE (a tokenizer-robust proxy for the Llama-3.1 BPE; the self/control RATIO is insensitive to tokenizer choice since both sets are tokenized identically). self_referential: mean 40.7 tok (median 40, range 28-57). control: mean 46.0 tok (median 45, range 34-62). Mean-length ratio self/control = 0.886 — within the pre-registered +/-15% tolerance (11.4% difference), so no pruning required per the protocol above. The imbalance direction (control slightly longer) is conservative for H_M: more control tokens can only raise act_ctrl, lowering the self/control activation ratio, biasing AGAINST finding self-referential features. PASS.
notes.rationale: These prompts are designed so that self_referential[] saturates first-person introspective, confessional, and meta-attentional content while control[] is designed to be ordinary procedural / declarative content with no self-reference. The ratio (act_self / act_ctrl) per feature is therefore a measure of how selectively that feature responds to self-referential content.
notes.audit: Hash of this file is committed to prereg.md before OSF lock. No edits after lock. If a Llama tokenizer audit fails length-match, the failing prompts are documented in a deviation log and replaced with hash-tracked substitutions.
